name: Coordinator Delegates to Research Chain (research-only mode)
description: Fires when a coordinator loop calls decide(action=delegate_research). Spawns the researcher-plan MVP chain framed for a research-only ask — the chain runs plan → gather → synthesize and terminates at reviewer-research (the synthesize loop emits decide(action=emit), not decide(action=architect)). Clean break from the legacy single-loop researcher role: SemTeams now has ONE research/dev chain primitive (researcher-plan), and the dispatch-time classification by coordinator selects the framing, not a separate role. ADR-029 product-shell wiring + ADR-041 MVP role compression. See configs/personas/fragments/coordinator/10-decision-contract.md for the action taxonomy.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-plan
on_enter.prompt:
A coordinator classified the user's message as a research-only ask (no build artifact required) and delegated to you (parent loop $entity.instance).

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result with loop_id=$entity.instance. The result is the coordinator's structured decide-tool terminal (JSON with action + reason + subtopics + retry_hint). The coordinator's `reason` field captures the user's intent and the rationale for routing to the research chain — that is your grounding for what to plan.

Iteration 2+ — emit a research plan per researcher-plan/10-plan-rules.md. Since this is a research-only chain, the synthesize phase will terminate the chain at reviewer-research (no architect / spec / build phases). Keep the plan focused on evidence gathering and synthesis; do NOT plan for build artifacts.

Terminal: decide(action="gather") to forward into the gather phase, decide(action="emit") only if the question is genuinely answerable from the plan itself without gather work, or decide(action="needs_clarification") if the coordinator's reason is too thin to plan from.

metadata.framing_note: chain_mode property is informational (publish_agent.properties does NOT propagate to triples on the spawned loop per the spec-mode-gate plumbing note in dev-via-spec/02-reviewer-approved-to-builder.json). The structural fork between research-only and dev-via-spec still happens at synthesize's decide() terminal under Slice 1 MVP. Slice 1b will add a chain.mode triple on the chain entity + a structural phase-validator check so synthesize's choice is enforced rather than trusted.
metadata.model_choice: research model — plan emission for an open-ended user ask benefits from the stronger research-tier model.
